title: Brasaland telemetry event and mandatory metric schemas
description: Validatable JSON Schema draft-07 export of Brasaland telemetry. Root is a oneOf over every catalog event under definitions. Event_type values follow the entity_action taxonomy (consistent verbs: created, adjusted, crossed, cleared, triggered, registered, detected, completed, recorded, shown, accepted, hired, separated, scheduled, opened, filled, published, acknowledged, dispatched, redeemed, transferred, succeeded, failed, rejected, ended, viewed, expired, raised, caught, updated). The envelope requires eventID, timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), sessionID, UserID, Event_type, SchemaVersion, requestID, and properties. definitions.mandatoryMetricSet is the complete observation schema for every CONTEXT.md mandatory metric. Property allowlists live in docs/telemetry/property-allowlists.md. Storage mapping is in docs/telemetry/telemetry-plan.md. Validate with a draft-07 implementation (e.g. jsonschema.Draft7Validator) with format checking enabled.

envelope.description: Brasaland standard event envelope. Mandatory keys are eventID, timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), sessionID, UserID, Event_type, SchemaVersion, requestID, and properties. source and tags are also required so the pipeline and the engineering reader stay aligned.

productCreated.description: POST /inventory after create_product writes products.csv. Map CSV name to product_name.

stockCountAdjusted.description: PATCH /inventory/{product_id} after apply_delta commits. reason is count_correction.

stockThresholdCrossed.description: Chain CSV edge: quantity_before >= 10 and quantity_after < 10. The weekly pipeline ignores this type.

stockThresholdCleared.description: Chain CSV edge: quantity_before < 10 and quantity_after >= 10.

inventoryValidationFailed.description: 422 on an inventory or order body. loc and pydantic type only. IP-3.

directStockEditRejected.description: Direct stock change or alert threshold the API refuses. CSV is unchanged. IP-4.

inboundOrderCreated.description: One event per inbound line. Pipeline sums payload.cost into total_purchase_cost.

outboundOrderCreated.description: One event per outbound line. Guest tickets use sale_completed.

stockWasteRegistered.description: Shift-close waste log. Pipeline sums payload.cost into total_waste_cost.

properties.note: Trim discarded after a cut error on the rib station.

stockThresholdTriggered.description: Location-scoped downward crossing, or protein cover under 3 days. Pipeline counts rows.

ingredientPriceVarianceDetected.description: Previous unit price for product_id + supplier_id + currency moved by at least 1 percent. Pipeline counts rows.

saleCompleted.description: One closed ticket. points_earned is floor(amount/10000) for COP and floor(amount/10) for USD.

locationSalesSilenceDetected.description: Open location with no sale_completed for 45 minutes. Reuse id for the episode.

loyaltyPointsRedeemed.description: Redemption in multiples of 5 points once balance_before is at least 15. 5 points discount 20000 COP or 20 USD.

loyaltyCardTransferred.description: One-time physical stamp card transfer onto an app account, at a location.

userLoginSucceeded.description: POST /auth/login or POST /auth/token after authenticate_user succeeds. UserID is users.id.

userLoginFailed.description: 401 branch of the login handlers. No email or password.

pageViewed.description: Public corporate home mount. path is /.

authFormRejected.description: Staff form blocked a submit, or the matching HTTP 422 was shown. No email or password. The server does not emit a second copy.

sessionExpired.description: JWT past exp. Emitted on ExpiredSignatureError before decode_access_token collapses the error. Distinct from user_login_failed.

sessionRejected.description: Invalid JWT, inactive subject, or a protected route opened with no token. Distinct from session_expired and user_login_failed.

sessionEnded.description: Logout, or a later 401 cleared the stored token. Does not restate expired versus invalid.

accountUpdated.description: Register, profile save, or password change finished or was refused. No contact fields.

apiLatencyRecorded.description: One apiRequest, including network failure. route_template has no query string.

uiLatencyRecorded.description: Session, panel, or form clock until success, error, or the effect was cancelled.

clientExceptionCaught.description: Error boundary, window error, or unhandled rejection. error_name only. No message and no stack.

sectionViewed.description: Operator surface actually shown. required and ready are fixed per section id.

flowStepRecorded.description: One step of a staff flow. Abandoned and completed both close the flow_instance.

employeeHired.description: Hire fact for country headcount. employee_id is opaque. No name.

employeeSeparated.description: Leaver fact for people.turnover, segmented by country.

absenceRecorded.description: Absence day or fraction for people.absenteeism. Holiday taken is absence_kind holiday.

rosterDayScheduled.description: Denominator day for absenteeism. One row per employee per scheduled day.

vacancyOpened.description: Vacancy open date. Paired with vacancy_filled for time to fill.

vacancyFilled.description: days_to_fill is filled_on minus opened_on in calendar days.

customerPreferenceRecorded.description: CRM preference. No free-text personal data.

recommendationShown.description: Personalisation impression. customer_id is optional when the guest is anonymous.

recommendationAccepted.description: Guest accepted the suggested menu item. recommendation_id matches the impression.

recipeUpdatePublished.description: Recipe push. locale es is the base language. en is an additional publish.

recipeUpdateAcknowledged.description: One location confirms it has the recipe version. Coverage denominator is 14.

weeklyReportDispatched.description: Monday executive report send. floor_metric_ids must list every Phase 1 floor id.

mandatoryMetricObservation.description: One published value for a CONTEXT.md mandatory metric. status null_pending_writer means the writer is not live yet; value must be null.

value.description: Computed number, boolean, object, or null when the writer is pending.

mandatoryMetricSet.description: Complete set of observations for every CONTEXT.md mandatory metric. Exactly one row per floor metric id.
